description: OpenClaw Hooks Configuration - Event-driven automation framework

PreToolUse.description: Triggered before any tool is executed. Useful for security checks, validation, or logging.

PostToolUse.description: Triggered after a tool has completed. Useful for cleanup, analytics, or triggering follow-up actions.

OnSessionStart.description: Triggered when a new session begins. Useful for loading context or initializing state.

handlers.description: Load context and initialize session state

OnSessionEnd.description: Triggered when a session ends. Useful for saving state, generating summaries, or cleaning up resources.

handlers.description: Save session state and generate summary

OnError.description: Triggered when an error occurs. Useful for error logging, recovery, or alerting.

handlers.description: Log errors and suggest recovery actions
